_comment: Compute cost peg — €/Mtoken, separate input/output, keyed by model id. This is CONFIG, not code: the operator edits it as providers/hardware change. It is the cost-discovered, honest peg the compute-register claim depends on. Local (ollama) rates are the amortized self-hosted cost from the 2026-05-21 sovereign-compute benchmark (consumer tier ~€27-31/mo); refine as real throughput is measured against the meter. Cloud rates track the BYOK provider's published price the operator actually pays. A model absent here falls back to the nearest listed rate of the same Claude family (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable; mythos uses fable) and is flagged estimated=true with 'rate: assumed' in the ledger source; only a model with no family match meters at rate 0, flagged estimated=true. Never put provider API keys in this file.
_note: Claude rates 2026-11-10: list prices from the claude-api skill reference 'Current Models (cached: 2026-09-25)' in USD per Mtoken (fable-5/5-1 10/50, opus-5-5 4/20, opus-5 and opus-4-8/4-7 5/25, sonnet-5-5 and sonnet-5 2/10, sonnet-4-6 3/15, haiku-4-5 1/5), converted at the file's existing peg of 0.93 EUR per USD (matches the sonnet-4-6 row 2.8/14 up to rounding). Corrected 2026-11-10: opus-4-8 and opus-4-7 were 14/70 (old Opus 4 era price), haiku-4-5 was 0.75/3.7; the reference gives opus 4.8/4.7 at 5/25 and haiku 4.5 at 1/5. Not in the reference, so not listed: opus-4-6 has a row there but was not asked for; mythos-5-1 (Project Glasswing only, same price as fable, served via the fable family fallback). Cache-read and cache-write prices are not metered (ledger has input/output only). Prices are first-party API rates; Bedrock/Vertex differ.
